notes: The requested gloss ("stand") and second citation (2Sam.20.11) belong to H5975 (עמד¹, the common, unrelated "stand", already in this dataset) -- that verse's word is tagged lemma 5975, not 5976. H5976 is a genuine homograph with its own distinct sense: Strong's gives "to shake" for H5976 itself (usage "be at a stand", an idiom, not the plain verb "stand"), and its one real attestation (Ezek.29.7, "madest all their loins to shake") matches that, not "stand". Shipped as "shake" with only the Ezek.29.7 citation -- this also resolves the person's own "(Non-hapax?)" flag: H5976 is a true hapax; the second occurrence they had in mind is H5975's. Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H5975 has been retroactively relabeled עמד¹ in this same batch and this root is עמד².
